title: 第13章 鸿雁传信第14章 前往林家
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
顾安趺坐在蒲团上，周身蓝色灵光萦绕，晨光从窗户探进来，照在脸上。
“吁”
长出一口气，星目豁的睁开，眼神里透着无奈。
修炼一晚上，只增长一丝灵力，这修仙之路，当真艰难！
还好有【灵源回馈】作为助力，这长生仙路才有资格去追逐。
顾安缓步出屋，这时白芷青榴已弄好早饭，一碗粥，一碟咸菜而已。
用过饭后，正打算去看看黑灵鱼群，一声嘹亮的雁鸣响彻云霄，顾安蓦地站起身，神情凝重。
这雁鸣如此嘹亮，飞行间带起的狂风扑面而来，散发着的灵压让顾安倍感压力，最让人不安的是，这大雁似乎直直地朝他飞来。
“这是冲我来的？还是感受到湖里的灵气，前来捕食？真他娘的倒霉，怎么会刚巧不巧的出现妖兽！！”
顾安感受到越来越近的灵压，估摸着应该是只炼气后期的妖兽，远非自己可敌，将灵气凝聚在脚底，全力催发轻身术，像支离弦的箭一样飞奔出去。
灵鱼没了可以再养，任务丢了大不了受罚，可命只有一条，此时不跑，更待何时。
可那大雁见顾安跑得飞快，双翅一震，速度竟又快了两成。
顾安感受到后面越来越近的风声与灵压，不由得有些绝望，转身一看，那大雁浑身布满紫色云纹，双翅展开足有三丈长。
顾安认出此雁名为紫云雁，在炼气后期的妖兽中也是飞的极快的那一种。
“不能再跑了，被追上更完，不如省些灵力，拼死一搏。”身临险境，顾安也不是没有拼命的觉悟。
猛地一转身，青元剑从储物袋中招出，碧影针藏于袖中蓄势待发，右手捏着一颗灵石，灵力涌动，一根水矛在空中迅速成形。
水矛掷出，却被紫云雁双翅一合，挡了下来，只打落几根雁羽。
“昂～”
紫云雁啼叫一声，一封信从腹部的绒羽中飞出，啪的一声糊在顾安脸上。
等等，好像有什么不对。

顾安呆了一下，察觉到事情好像被自己想差了，抬头再看紫云雁，它眼中的怒火似乎燃烧起来，一双雁翅劈头盖脸的砸下，砸的顾安手忙脚乱。
“昂～昂～”紫云雁一边砸一边愤怒的控诉。
它就是个送信的，来到这却发现收信人拔腿就跑，追了半天追上了，又被一大团水糊在身上，打掉了它漂亮的羽毛。
顾安感觉到紫云雁没用灵力，又自觉理亏，便没有还手，任它发泄。
心里嘀咕着这是哪位的灵兽，灵兽都炼气后期，主人的修为还不知多高呢！想到这，更不敢躲开。
万一是个小心眼的再记恨就不妙了！
发泄了一会，顾安的头发被拧成一团，乱糟糟的，紫云雁似乎也觉得没意思，停了下来，只是还气呼呼的看着顾安。
顾安见紫云雁的心情似有好转，连连道歉。
“恕罪恕罪，我感受到强大的灵压，慌乱交加，酿成此错。这样，我请您吃灵鱼，您看怎么样。”
尽管心中疼的滴血，可为了平息紫云雁的怒火，顾安许出了黑灵鱼为赔礼
听到有灵鱼做赔礼，紫云雁总算不是气呼呼的了。
“昂昂”
这是答应了，顾安顾不得心疼，暗暗想道：“吃了我的灵鱼，总不能再告状了吧。”
content_en:
Gu Anfu was sitting on the futon, with a blue aura lingering around him. The morning light came in through the window and shone on his face.
"call"
Taking a long breath, Xing's eyes suddenly opened, with helplessness in his eyes.
After practicing for one night, I only gained a little spiritual power. This road to immortality is really difficult!
Fortunately, with the help of [Spiritual Source Feedback], I am qualified to pursue this Immortal Path.
Gu An walked out of the house slowly. At this time, Bai Zhi Qingliu had already prepared breakfast, which was just a bowl of porridge and a plate of pickles.
After dinner, he was about to go see the black fish school when a loud call of wild geese resounded through the sky. Gu An suddenly stood up with a solemn look on his face.
The wild goose's call was so loud that the strong wind brought up by the flight blew against his face. The spiritual pressure emitted made Gu An feel even more stressed. The most unsettling thing was that the wild goose seemed to be flying straight towards him.
"Is this coming for me? Or did you feel the aura in the lake and come to hunt for prey? What a damn unlucky thing. How could a monster appear by chance!!"
Gu An felt the spiritual pressure getting closer and closer. He guessed that it was a monster beast in the late stage of Qi refining, which was far invincible to him. He condensed the spiritual energy on the soles of his feet, activated the Light Body Technique with all his strength, and flew out like an arrow from the string.
If you lose the spiritual fish, you can raise it again. If you lose the mission, you will be punished. But you only have one life. If you don't run away now, you will wait until later.
But when the goose saw Gu An running very fast, its wings fluttered, and its speed actually increased by 20%.
Gu An felt the sound of wind and spiritual pressure getting closer and closer behind him, and couldn't help but feel a little desperate. He turned around and saw that the wild goose was covered with purple cloud patterns, and its wings were spread out to be three feet long.
Gu An recognized the goose as the Ziyun Goose, and it was the fastest flying goose among the monsters in the late stage of Qi refining.
"I can't run any longer, or I'll be overtaken, so why not save some spiritual energy and fight to the death." When he was in danger, Gu An didn't have the awareness to fight for his life.
Turning around suddenly, the Qingyuan Sword was summoned from the storage bag. The Biying Needle was hidden in the sleeve and ready to go. He held a spiritual stone in his right hand, spiritual power surged, and a water spear quickly formed in the air.
The water spear was thrown, but it was blocked by Ziyunyan's wings, knocking down only a few feathers.
"Ang~"
The Ziyunyan crowed, and a letter flew out from the feathers on its abdomen, hitting Gu An's face with a pop.
Wait, something seems wrong.
Gu An was stunned for a moment, realizing that he seemed to have missed the point. He raised his head and looked at Ziyunyan again. The anger in its eyes seemed to be burning, and a pair of wings of the goose flew down on its head and face, causing Gu An to panic.
"Ang~ang~" Zi Yunyan complained angrily while smashing.
It was a messenger, but when it arrived, it found that the recipient had run away. After chasing him for a long time, he caught up with him and was hit by a large ball of water, knocking off his beautiful feathers.
Gu An felt that Zi Yunyan was not using his spiritual power and felt that he was in the wrong, so he did not fight back and allowed it to vent its anger.
I muttered in my heart whose spirit beast this is. The spirit beasts are all in the late stage of Qi refining, and the master's cultivation level is still unknown! Thinking of this, I didn't dare to hide away.
It would be bad if you are a petty person and keep grudges!
After venting for a while, Gu An's hair was twisted into a ball and became messy. Zi Yunyan seemed to find it boring and stopped, but still looked at Gu An angrily.
Seeing that Zi Yunyan's mood seemed to be improving, Gu An apologized repeatedly.
"Forgive me. I felt strong spiritual pressure and panicked, which led to this mistake. In this case, I will treat you to a spiritual fish. What do you think?"
Although his heart was bleeding with pain, in order to calm Zi Yunyan's anger, Gu An promised to give him a black spirit fish as an apology.
After hearing that there was a spirit fish making an apology, Zi Yunyan was finally not angry anymore.
"Ang Ang"
This was a promise. Gu An couldn't care less about his heartache and thought to himself: "If you eat my spiritual fish, you can't complain anymore."
